items.title: Point CONTRIBUTING.md at the architecture summary and trim ADRs 0020 and 0050 under 40 lines

checks.command:
wc -l docs/adr/0020-pvtoken-guards-preview-fills.md docs/adr/0050-history-pushes-on-entering-a-column-rewrites-otherwise.md && python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

contributing = Path('"'"'CONTRIBUTING.md'"'"').read_text()
assert '"'"'Read the [architecture summary] first, then the sections of the'"'"' in contributing
assert '"'"'[architecture review] that the change touches, found by heading.'"'"' in contributing
assert '"'"'[architecture summary]: docs/ARCHITECTURE-SUMMARY.md'"'"' in contributing
for name in ('"'"'0020-pvtoken-guards-preview-fills.md'"'"', '"'"'0050-history-pushes-on-entering-a-column-rewrites-otherwise.md'"'"'):
    path = Path('"'"'docs/adr'"'"') / name
    before = subprocess.check_output(['"'"'git'"'"', '"'"'show'"'"', '"'"'f9b0f74f:'"'"' + str(path)], text=True)
    after = path.read_text()
    assert len(after.splitlines()) <= 39, (name, len(after.splitlines()))
    assert re.findall(r'"'"'^\[[^\]]+\]:.*$'"'"', before, re.M) == re.findall(r'"'"'^\[[^\]]+\]:.*$'"'"', after, re.M)
    assert re.findall(r'"'"'\d+'"'"', before) == re.findall(r'"'"'\d+'"'"', after)
    for heading in ('"'"'Context'"'"', '"'"'Decision'"'"', '"'"'Measurement'"'"', '"'"'Consequences'"'"'):
        assert '"'"'\n## '"'"' + heading + '"'"'\n'"'"' in after
    print(name, len(before.splitlines()), '"'"'->'"'"', len(after.splitlines()), '"'"'lines; links, numbers and required headings retained'"'"')
print('"'"'Summary-first instructions and review-by-heading verified'"'"')
'
timeout 600 uv run --project server pytest -q server/tests/test_docs.py server/tests/test_review_conditions.py

git diff --check f9b0f74fe9f1f0c14343ab76262b7e63c0895e40 HEAD && git diff --stat f9b0f74fe9f1f0c14343ab76262b7e63c0895e40 HEAD && python3 -c 'import subprocess
allowed = {'"'"'CONTRIBUTING.md'"'"', '"'"'docs/adr/0020-pvtoken-guards-preview-fills.md'"'"', '"'"'docs/adr/0050-history-pushes-on-entering-a-column-rewrites-otherwise.md'"'"', '"'"'docs/tasks/158-point-contributing-md-at-the-architecture-summary-and-trim-adrs-0020-a.md'"'"'}
changed = set(subprocess.check_output(['"'"'git'"'"','"'"'diff'"'"','"'"'--name-only'"'"','"'"'f9b0f74fe9f1f0c14343ab76262b7e63c0895e40'"'"','"'"'HEAD'"'"'],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed == allowed, changed
print('"'"'Delivery contains only the four permitted documents'"'"')
'
